entries.c8607028d51b7139: Starting its 4th Medium-Term Management Plan in fiscal 2025, the company aims to achieve sustainable growth and establish competitive advantage under the slogan “Make the true customer-first perspective the absolute value and keep challenging the transformation of management structure.” The company is promoting share gains in the Tokyo metropolitan area through the establishment of the new company AEON Food Style and maximizing synergies through the integration of functions and systems, and is advancing responses tailored to regional characteristics by dividing its stores into three areas (downtown, urban and rural) and strengthening the group-wide centralized management of joint sales promotion and sales measures.
entries.c97b17cb965a5d17: Maruetsu Fresh Foods processes fresh food; Rose Corporation and Kasumi Green process, manufacture and sell food products; Kasumi Mirai processes and packages vegetables; and Sun Food Japan purchases and sells food products and manufactures prepared side dishes, supporting the stores' product assortment. All of these are classified under the Supermarket Business.
